backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual InventoryNet is read as a raw SEC Companyfacts balance-sheet INSTANT fact (no FY duration) and matched to annual CostOfRevenue ending the same fiscal-year date; both are known only by filed date (<= signal date). Current DIO uses average current/prior inventory over current COGS, prior DIO uses average prior/pre-prior inventory over prior COGS, and the rule requires DIO to improve year over year. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: raw SEC companyfacts annual InventoryNet instant facts
raw SEC companyfacts annual CostOfRevenue facts
raw SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

2_history_check.exp-20260528-019: Rejected working-capital discipline (stable receivables/revenue and inventory/revenue as an FGRS support scalar). This run is a standalone candidate-pool source testing DIO/turnover trajectory, not inventory/revenue stability.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-031: Rejected operating-efficiency (asset turnover = revenue/assets). This run tests inventory turnover/DIO specifically, a demand-side balance-sheet field tied to COGS, not total asset turnover.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-002: Rejected low asset-growth quality. This run tests inventory contraction relative to sales, not broad balance-sheet growth.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-016: Rejected operating leverage acceleration. This run tests an input inventory-efficiency field rather than an operating-income outcome.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-018: Rejected inventory-to-revenue leanness despite strong aggregate EV/PnL because old_thin regressed and drawdown drift was too high. Its closeout and the playbook allow DIO trajectory as the materially different inventory-quality evidence.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: The latest inventory/revenue scout was directionally strong but failed old_thin and drawdown; the playbook explicitly names days-inventory-outstanding trajectory as the materially different PIT evidence needed. This tests InventoryNet plus CostOfRevenue turnover rather than another inventory/revenue threshold. Risk is high because CostOfRevenue coverage may be thin and the field may still relabel liquid momentum.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual InventoryNet instant fact, missing matching FY CostOfRevenue, missing pre-prior inventory point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC InventoryNet instant mapping, filed-date PIT CostOfRevenue annual facts, DIO/turnover improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
